Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Nuggets.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 58 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 206 and 255 total points.

analyst.text: Nikola Jokic (elbow) and Aaron Gordon (lower-body management) both played on Nov 9 after questionable tags, so their absence here is not confirmed. Check the final report. Denver are also coming off a draining Mexico City trip and a loss in Houston. Memphis are the league's only unbeaten road team but have injuries of their own (Isaiah Stewart, Scotty Pippen Jr.). Travel fatigue leans slightly toward Memphis.
